_readme: What may be committed to this repository. Content is data; the mechanic is the pre-commit hook beside
this file, installed by .claude/hooks/session-start.sh (git config core.hooksPath toolkit/git-hooks).
WHY A HOOK AND NOT A RULE. Retention already caps the WORKING TREE, and that was never the problem. A
register committed once stays in history at full size forever, because xlsx is a zip git cannot
delta-compress, so a repository that commits a 12 to 24 MB workbook on every build grows by that much on
every build no matter what the tree holds. Between 11-Sep-2026 and 18-Sep-2026 that came to 23 registers
and 288 MB, cleared only by rewriting history. No policy document prevents a recurrence; refusing the
THE TEST IS REPRODUCIBILITY, NOT SIZE. A file that a script in this repository can rebuild is an output
and does not belong in history; a file nothing here can rebuild is an input and must be kept. That is why
PS_WP_Transaction_Register_3FY_v127_CANDIDATE.xlsx is allowed at 24 MB while a 12 MB register this
repository builds is not: the candidate is the root input every build inherits from and no script here
produces it, whereas pbr_build.py rebuilds the branch register and pswp_build_batch.py rebuilds the
Override for a single commit with PBR_ALLOW_BIG=1 when you genuinely mean it. The hook says so when it
refuses, and names the file and the reason.

deny_globs.why: Binder and invoice attachments are evidence, not repository artefacts. The corpus retains page_text and the M1 verdict is retained in the batch's mask_screen record; the binder itself is deleted once parsed (pbr_binder_retention.py).

The three pull reports are outputs, rebuilt by pbr_reports.py --build from the shipped registers, and each set costs about 1.9 MB of history per version. The .md of each report IS committed: it is small, diffable, and the readable record.

allow_paths.why: Root build INPUT, not an output. Read by every branch build (pbr_stage.V127), its md5 stamped into the shipped workbook, and no script in this repository can produce it. 24 MB, committed once, never reissued.
The two standing Council reference documents the JSON captures in data/reference/ were made from, and the authority those captures are verified against. Not attachments.
TechOne exports: SE2, ledger transactions, creditor histories, journal pulls and reconstructions. Build inputs, embedded verbatim and md5-screened, and nothing here can regenerate them.
